scope: Practice unlock progress, history accuracy colors and concrete history titles

changes.learningCard: Removed the practice-direction row including 通用英语. Replaced the 单元挑战 heading with a progress bar and n / 1,000 聊天字符. Exact status text is 单元练习已解锁 or 单元练习尚未解锁. Level, stars and start/continue action remain in the same card.
changes.accuracy: Only 答对 n/m uses green at >=70%, amber at >=50% and <70%, red below 50%. Continue/pending labels remain secondary; actual earned points are unchanged.

historyTitles.isolation: Bindings hash title, summary, scene, originalGroup and full questions, excluding role/attempt IDs. Changed question content cannot inherit a reviewed title merely through a matching unit ID.

historyTitles.preservation: Display projection only; frozen snapshots, raw titles, source catalog, grading and rewards are preserved.
